# TheStage Apple SDK — agent index
# Source of truth for customer Markdown: docs/*.md (scrubbed to dist/docs/)

## Init (required)
- Swift: TheStageAI.shared.initialize(api_token:)
- Flutter: TheStageFlutterSDK.initialize(api_token:)
- Seat: (apiToken, deviceId) — see licensing.md / product_terms.md
- Pricing: Service Request at https://app.thestage.ai/contact — no public rate card

## Imports (shipped customer docs)
- Swift: import TheStageSDK
- Flutter: package:thestage_apple_sdk/thestage_apple_sdk.dart

## Core symbols
- TheStageAI (singleton): start_model, stop_model, infer, infer_stream, open_tts_streamer, prefetch_engines, logging helpers
  (load_models(_:on_load_progress:) with TSModelStartRequest; is_pack_resident(engines_path:revision:);
  specialization_health(for:); delete_model(engines_path:revision:) -> freed_bytes — see loading.md)
- TSLLM
  (LLMGenerationConfig.speculative_decoding: nil = pack policy, false = plain, true = require a drafter; same field on ASRGenerationConfig)
- TSChatSession (llm.chat_session) — multi-turn memory + Path A tools
- TSVLM
- WhisperPipeline, Qwen3ASRPipeline, ParakeetASRPipeline
  (ASRGenerationConfig.language: ISO code or "auto"; ASRStreamingConfig.session_language:
  ASRSessionLanguageConfig(enabled: true, detect_s: 10))
- ASREngine(config: TSAgentConfig(vad:stt:speakers: .conversation(voices:final_pass:diarizer:speaker_model:)))
  — speakers on infer / start+stop / open_stream+close; ASRSpeakerConfig for loaded pipelines
- NemotronDiarizationPipeline (TheStageAI/Nemotron-3-Diarization): infer / open_stream → DiarizationResult
- SpeakerIDPipeline (TheStageAI/speaker-id-v2): infer(audio:) / enroll(audio:id:name:)
- SpeakerVoices(file:speaker_model:): enroll / save / add / rename / remove / all
- NeuTTSMultilingualPipeline, Qwen3TTSPipeline, PhononTTSPipeline (Phonon / Pocket TTS packs)
  (prefer neutts-nano-multilingual; full neutts-multilingual temporarily out)
- EmbeddingPipeline (TheStageAI/embeddinggemma-2): infer(text: / image: / audio: / video: / inputs:, task:, dimension:)
  -> EmbeddingResult; EmbeddingPipeline.similarity(_:_:); tasks .QUERY / .DOCUMENT
- SileroVAD
- TSVoiceAgent, TSAgentConfig, TSLocalLLMProvider, TSOpenAICompatibleProvider
- SpeakerEmbedding (family thestage_speaker_embedding; often model_name speaker_id)
- Tool / ToolDefinition / ToolCall / ToolCalling / DefaultTools
  (Path A: chat_session / infer_stream(tools: [Tool]); Path B: definitions + executor: nil)
- AudioIO (load_wav / write_wav), ImageIOHelpers (load_cgimage)
- AECMethod (vpio / neural / none) on agent audio config

## Pages
- llm.md — TSLLM
- vlm.md — TSVLM (LFM2.5-VL; Gemma-4 E2B text-only)
- asr.md — WhisperPipeline + Qwen3ASRPipeline + ParakeetASRPipeline, language ("auto" / codes)
- diarization.md — speakers in ASR (SpeakerSetup / ASRSpeakerConfig), NemotronDiarizationPipeline
- tts.md — NeuTTS + Qwen3-TTS + Phonon / Pocket TTS
- embedding.md — EmbeddingPipeline (text / image / audio / video, Matryoshka sizes)
- loading.md — load_models, prefetch, is_pack_resident, specialization_health, delete_model
- vad.md — SileroVAD
- streaming.md — stream contracts
- voice_agent.md — full agent (sample_rate_* / aec_method)
- speaker_embedding.md — SpeakerIDPipeline, SpeakerVoices, naming rule, JSON cosine verify
- licensing.md — initialize registers; seat pair
- product_terms.md — pointer to full Product Terms
- logging.md — session log / debugReport

## Audio rates
- VAD / Whisper / diarization / speaker embedding input: 16 kHz mono Float
- Language "auto": a window needs ~8 s to detect; batch votes over the first windows with
  speech; a live session detects once over 10 s of speech and keeps that language
- VAD frame: 512 samples
- TTS codec output (NeuTTS / Qwen3-TTS): 24 kHz mono Float
- Standalone TTS: TTSGenerationConfig.sample_rate_out (Hz) polyphase-resamples
  infer / infer_stream (JSON also accepts sample_rate_out_khz)
- Voice agent: sample_rate_in / sample_rate_out / tts_sample_rate;
  AudioEngineNode resamples TTS → sample_rate_out
- Speaker embedding window: 2.0 s

## Flutter mirror
- start_model / stop_model / infer / infer_stream / send / finish_stream / stop_stream / on_progress

## Out of scope here
- Wake-word engines / dedicated wake-word guide (out of this release)
